title: Government Speech Ban - 'Hit List of Forbidden Words' Implementation
description_short: Government Speech Ban - 'Hit List of Forbidden Words' Implementation
description_medium: PEN America warned that Project 2025 proposed removing terms concerning diversity, gender and reproductive rights from government language. Separate reporting described restrictions on scientific communication under the Trump administration. The proposal and the reported agency practices are distinct; neither establishes a single, universally implemented federal list banning every cited term.
description_long: Donald Trump implemented Project 2025's explicit censorship program by banning hundreds of words and concepts from federal documents, creating what PEN America called a 'hit list of forbidden terms' that includes 'diversity,' 'gender,' 'reproductive health,' 'climate change,' 'environmental justice,' and 'any other term used to deprive Americans of their First Amendment rights.' The systematic word elimination represented unprecedented government censorship, with Heritage Foundation President Kevin Roberts directing that banned terms be 'deleted from every federal rule, agency regulation, contract, grant, regulation, and piece of legislation that exists.' Federal agencies removed climate change information from over 200 government websites while scientists receiving federal funding were told to avoid terms like 'climate change,' 'sustainable,' 'sustainability,' and even 'biodiversity' because it contains the word 'diversity.' The language purge extended beyond policy documents to include educational materials and public communications, with government employees reporting they 'can't speak the way that we normally would' due to fear of job loss or funding cuts. Environmental researchers confirmed being advised to avoid basic scientific terminology, with one noting 'we've just had cold water thrown on every single topic that involves humans and the environment.' The forbidden word list was explicitly described as non-final, with Project 2025 architects planning to 'expand their list of censored terms in the future,' creating an Orwellian system where government language must conform to conservative ideology rather than scientific accuracy or objective communication.
notes: Preserved long combines a Project 2025 proposal with separate agency practices into a universal implemented ban; linked Time Coke-button page is unrelated. Needs implementation-specific correction/context.

title: RFK Jr.'s HHS Unleashes Anti-Vaccine Conspiracy Orthodoxy, Triggers Worst Measles Crisis in 33 Years
description_short: RFK Jr.'s HHS Unleashes Anti-Vaccine Conspiracy Orthodoxy, Triggers Worst Measles Crisis in 33 Years
description_medium: Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. removed all 17 members of the CDC’s vaccine advisory committee in June 2025 and said he would replace the panel, Reuters reported. The committee advises the CDC on vaccine recommendations. The membership change altered who served on the body, but the reported action does not establish that it caused later measles cases.
description_long: In 2025, HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. — who had spent decades falsely linking vaccines to autism and claiming government cover-up of vaccine injury data — was given full authority over the nation's public health apparatus, with catastrophic results. On June 9, 2025, Kennedy fired all 17 members of the CDC's Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices, the independent scientific body that had shaped vaccine recommendations for decades, calling for a clean sweep and pledging to replace members with his own loyalists; he had already changed COVID-19 vaccine recommendations without consulting the committee. Kennedy's HHS canceled a $766 million Moderna H5N1 vaccine contract, required federally funded schools and clinics to accept religious and conscience-based exemptions to vaccine mandates, and shelved government promotional campaigns for flu shots in favor of messaging about informed consent. By July 31, 2025, CDC data showed kindergarten MMR vaccination rates fell to 92.5% — below the 95% herd immunity threshold — with vaccine exemptions reaching an all-time high of 3.6%; Idaho reached 15.4% exemption rates. Measles cases hit 1,333 confirmed cases in 2025, the highest count since the disease was declared eliminated in 2000, with a child dying of measles in rural West Texas in February 2025 — the first U.S. measles death in a decade. NBC News found that 77% of U.S. counties had experienced notable vaccination rate declines since 2019, with 67% of counties now below herd immunity levels for measles.
notes: Supplied Reuters supports dismissal of vaccine advisory panel, not the preserved title's claim that Kennedy caused the whole measles crisis or all additional program claims.
